title: Union Cabinet (11 Nov 2026) approves ₹2,390 crore Noida Metro Aqua Line extension, Noida Sector 51 to Greater Noida Sector 4 (Greater Noida West): 8.449 km, five elevated stations, interchange with Delhi Metro Blue Line at Noida Sector 61; Noida-Greater Noida network to 71.878 km; about four years to build (Mint, ET); serves Gaur City 1 & 2, Cleo County, Sector 60 offices (PIB); announced by Ashwini Vaishnaw
